29.desc:
Live Rosin is a solventless concentrate made using fresh frozen cannabis plant material. The
frozen plant material is first put through an ice water extraction process which separates the
trichome glands from the plant material. Those trichome glands are then dried using extremely
cold temperatures to remove the moisture. Once dried, the collection of trichome glands are
pressed through a 25 micron filter utilizing heat and pressure to melt the rest away from the
trichome glands and plant material. The result is an un-adulterated form of cannabis resin that
is a direct representation of the cultivar used to make it.
All Rosin is resin but not all resin is rosin. Rosin gets its name due to how it's made. A
concentrate can only be called rosin if the concentrate was made using heat and pressure to
separate the resin from plant material.
This Live Rosin was crafted from fresh frozen flower expertly cultivated by Clade 9, this Live
rosin vape delivers a pristine flavor and cannabinoid profile with uncompromising quality. Made
by using only ice water, heat and pressure capturing the most unadulterated expression of the
plant's terpene rich profile for a clean flavorful hit every time.

Storage and transport information:
1.) Store in a cool, dry place away from heat and direct sunlight. Refrigeration Recommended
for freshness and texture preservation.
2.) Melt products are transported using temperature-controlled procedures to preserve quality
consistency and compliance

341.desc: RSO, or Rick Simpson Oil, is named after a Canadian cancer patient turned cannabis activist. RSO is sometimes referred to as a "whole plant" or "full spectrum" extract because it retains the full cannabinoid, terpene, and chlorophyll profile of the source material by using specific solvents.

342.desc:
“Diamonds” from Strike is not a flower strain but a high-potency, crystalline concentrate line, typically sold as THCA diamonds in a 1 g format. These diamonds are a form of cannabinoid isolate, made by isolating and purifying THC-A into sparkling, gem-like crystals, often with nearly pure cannabinoid content and little to no CBD, emphasizing maximum psychoactive potential. They can be used on their own for dabbing or are sometimes paired with terpene-rich “sauce” to reintroduce flavor and a more rounded terpene profile.

The experience tends to be intense and fast-acting, with a rapid, full-body high that can feel heavy and deeply relaxing, especially for intermediate and advanced users. Many people use Strike Diamonds when they want a clean, punchy hit with little plant-matter flavor, letting the terpene additives or the strain used in the extract carry the taste and entourage effects. Because of their strength, they’re usually recommended for experienced consumers who already know how they respond to high-potency concentrates and who want a compact, efficient way to achieve a strong, focused session.

343.desc: Concentrated cannabis products come in a wide variety of consistencies, compositions, and potencies. Cannabinoids are isolated and removed from plant material via extraction, agitation, compression, or other methods to create generally a very potent product. Concentrates have an immediate activation time and are generally used by experienced consumers.

344.desc: Live Resin is a unique form of concentrate in that the flower used is frozen immediately after harvest, rather than the typical process of curing. Freezing the raw cannabis flower helps preserve terpene and cannabinoid profiles, providing consumers with a robust flavor profile and precise effects.

345.desc:
RYTHM’s team uses just ice, water, heat and pressure to craft Live Rosin extracts. The result: 100% chemical-free solventless concentrates that are the culmination of clean AF, true-to-plant taste—exactly like their growers intended. Expect only the plant's purest quality and most complete terpene profiles. Plus, much like fine wine, the rosin in RYTHM Solventless develops unique flavors as it ages. Their team is especially psyched about the smooth, long-lasting tastes that linger on the palate, easier exhales and gentler nose feel. Cannabis connoisseurs, this one’s for you.
RYTHM Tier 1 Solventless Concentrates are the best of the best. Top-tier quality with maximum flavor, potency, and terpenes. | [orig[ Face Off OG x Animal Mints] is a potent indica-leaning strain with a complex flavor profile of sweet mint, citrus, and nuts with hints of pine and diesel.

346.desc: Rosin is a form of concentrate that uses heat and pressure to extract cannabinoids, rather than solvents. Depending on the source material used for the extraction, rosin can vary widely in clarity and consistency.

347.desc:
Live Rosin is a solventless concentrate made using fresh frozen cannabis plant material. The
frozen plant material is first put through an ice water extraction process which separates the
trichome glands from the plant material. Those trichome glands are then dried using extremely
cold temperatures to remove the moisture. Once dried, the collection of trichome glands are
pressed through a 25 micron filter utilizing heat and pressure to melt the rest away from the
trichome glands and plant material. The result is an un-adulterated form of cannabis resin that
is a direct representation of the cultivar used to make it.
All Rosin is resin but not all resin is rosin. Rosin gets its name due to how it's made. A
concentrate can only be called rosin if the concentrate was made using heat and pressure to
separate the resin from plant material.

360.desc:
Cannabinoid Breakdown & Dosage

The "Trifecta 2:2:1" ratio means that for every 2 parts of CBD and CBN, there is 1 part of THC. 
Per Piece Dosing: Each individual fruit chew contains 10mg CBD, 10mg CBN, and 5mg THC.
Total Package Content (10-pack): The entire package delivers a total of 100mg CBD, 100mg CBN, and 50mg active THC. (Note: The "100mg" label on the package typically highlights the main therapeutic components, CBD and CBN, while keeping the psychoactive THC component at a lower 50mg total threshold to ensure sedation without overwhelming psychoactivity).

Targeted Effects
This specific cannabinoid profile leverages the "entourage effect" to promote healthy rest: 
CBN (Cannabinol): Formed as THC breaks down, this minor cannabinoid is highly regarded for its deeply sedative properties and ability to ease restlessness.
CBD (Cannabidiol): Works heavily with the body's endocannabinoid system to assist with physical relaxation, tension release, and reducing bedtime irritability. 
THC (Tetrahydrocannabinol): Present in a lower, controlled dose to help initiate sleep and enhance the overall therapeutic efficacy of the non-psychoactive cannabinoids.

Product Features
Dietary-Friendly: These fruit chews are 100% Vegan, Gluten-Free, and Dairy-Free.
Clean Ingredients: Formulated with real fruit flavors and contain no high-fructose corn syrup.
Flavor Profile: A sweet, ripe, and juicy watermelon flavor that masks the taste of the hemp extract. (A Sour Sleepy Watermelon variant is also available from the brand if you prefer a tangy finish). 

Consumption Tips
Onset Time: Because edibles are digested through the stomach and liver, effects typically take 45 minutes to 2 hours to fully manifest. It is highly recommended to take them roughly an hour before you plan to sleep. 
Dosing Advice: If you are new to THC or CBN, consider starting with half a chew (2.5mg THC / 5mg CBD / 5mg CBN) to gauge your personal sensitivity before moving to a full piece.

HOW BOVEDA WORKS: Boveda 62% RH keeps items fresh by stabilizing the humidity inside your airtight container. If the air inside your container is too moist, Boveda absorbs that moisture. If it's too dry, Boveda releases moisture into your container to bring what’s inside back to life. ADD A BOVEDA PACK RIGHT AWAY TO EVERY JAR, TIN OR BAG OF NEW ITEMS. You can also use Boveda 62 to restore overly dry items to its original vibrant state—the way nature intended.
CHOOSE BOVEDA: Boveda's the only patented 2-way humidity control solution with 25 years of experience. Using saltwater in our humidity packs, we provide the fastest, most precise humidity control in the market. When you invest in flavorful, aromatic, potent items, you want to ensure they stay fresh. Boveda is the only humidity solution that can do so within 24-48 hours.
HOW TO USE: It takes seconds to keep your natural items fresh. Remove the moisture packs from the resealable bag, slip the Boveda 62 humidity pack into your airtight container, fill the jar with your items, & close it. BOVEDA DOES THE REST. 758.desc:
Lookah Snail is one of the best 510 thread batteries. It is smaller than most pen-style batteries and compatible with all types of 510 units. 

The Lookah Snail features a 350mAh battery capacity with a 510 thread connection. The snail doesn't have temperature control heat settings; instead, it uses three variable voltage settings for the facility regulation. This is a similar way many mods work. The snail is not draw-activated but has a preheat mode.

The Lookah Snail features easy single-button operation.
Five (5) clicks will turn the unit on or off.
Three (3) clicks will adjust between three different voltage settings 3.2V - 3.6V - 4.2V. 
The integrated 350mAh battery is protected from over-time running, short-circuit, over-wattage, or overcharging. 
Once the voltage is running low, the LED blinks ten times to remind the user to charge the battery. After showing the low-power alert three (3) times, the system will lock the device until it has been recharged. 

The Lookah Snail pen batteries are charged through the Micro-USB port with a USB adapter at 0.5A. While charging, the LED light remains red, and once it's fully charged, the LED light will change color to green.
From fully charged, the Snail has a battery life of about 30 to 40 uses, depending on the battery voltage setting, what type of 510 thread units are being used, and the time for each hit. 

Package Content:
1 Snail Device
1 USB Cable
1 User Manual

For home-rolling pros, these wood tips for joints fit nicely inside your hand-rolled joints like any other crutch or filter but the wood filter tips provide a nice bit of weight and a premium feel while the wood tips cool the smoke and protect against any “scooby snacks” from getting through. 858.desc:
imited Edition Timeless x Chad Keith Battery + Flip Case Combo

We’re excited to introduce the Timeless x Chad Keith Artist Legacy Collaboration. Chad Keith’s artistic style is a raw, unapologetic blend of "easy, trashy, and sloppy," as he likes to describe it. His artwork lies in the space between playful and scary, drawing viewers in with bold designs. Drawing from a variety of mediums—including airbrush, paintbrush, and even his fingers—Chad brings his unique vision to life with an energy that’s as unpolished as it is captivating. His work is deeply inspired by the old horror movies he grew up watching; combining neon, horror-infused motifs.

We took special consideration to keep both you and your Timeless Vape clean with the Timeless Flip Case & Battery Combo, fashioned specifically for discretion while medicating. This unique case is specifically made to fit the Timeless Vapes TV6 battery when attached to any of our Timeless cartridges. The plastic case is 5 inches by 1 inch at its widest. 859.desc:
A tenured creative director, Lyons has worked with Nike, Converse, Diesel, Proctor & Gamble, Coca-Cola, American Express, and more. He won the 2010 EMMY Award for Outstanding Achievement in Main Title Design for contributing to the PBS series Avec Eric and a Cannes Golden Lion for leading Diesel's "Be Stupid" campaign. During his 7 years at Urban Outfitters, Lyons helped shape the brand holistically and led the company's acclaimed music program. Lyons has also held positions as Design Director for Stussy Worldwide, Art Director for Spike Jonze's Girl Skateboards, and Senior Designer for Nike, Inc.

"Timeless has shaped its Artist Legacy Program for the past few years, and Kevin elevated the program with his Artist Logo Remix," said Josh Rhodes, Timeless Artist Liaison. "For his flip case and battery, a staple accessory of the Timeless brand, Kevin infused his iconic characters into the Timeless drip logo featuring the colors of our three signature moods, transforming a practical accessory into a work of art embodying the energy and innovation that drive art, skateboarding, and streetwear."

Click button 5x fast to turn on & off

Click button 2x fast to preheat in cold weather or if cartridge clogs; wait for lights to cycle through, then press button & inhale
Heat settings: Low (Green, 2.6V), medium low (Blue, 3.0V), medium high (Purple, 3.4V), high (Red, 3.8V)

Black Widow + Durban Poison 2G Dual Vape 3-in-1

Experience full control and versatility with our 2G Dual Vape, featuring two completely separate 1G all-glass tanks for each strain. • Smooth airflow with consistent vapor production

Black Widow (Sativa-Dominant Hybrid)

A highly potent strain known for its intense, euphoric head high and strong overall effects. Black Widow delivers a powerful rush of happiness and mental uplift, followed by a deep relaxing body feel. This strain is best suited for experienced users, offering a heavy, long-lasting experience that can also help ease stress, tension, and discomfort.

Durban Poison (Sativa)

A pure sativa strain known for its energizing and uplifting effects. Durban Poison delivers a strong, happy head high that promotes creativity, focus, and motivation, making it ideal for daytime use. With its sweet, earthy flavor and powerful cerebral effects, it is perfect for staying productive while maintaining a positive mindset.

Combined Experience

Use both tanks at the same time to create a unique balance of powerful euphoria and energetic focus. The combination delivers a strong cerebral boost with a smooth body feel, giving you a versatile experience that can be both uplifting and relaxing depending on how you use it.
